fields.name: recovery_state
doc: /// A receipt cannot establish identity after name reuse. No automatic unlink is authorized.

fields.name: policy_sha256
doc: /// Host hash of the submitted (controller-resolved) source bytes.

fields.name: policy_received_sha256
doc: /// The worker's own hash of the bytes it read before compiling, when published.

fields.name: step_id
doc: /// The offending step's ID, omitted when the step ID itself is the refused
/// field: a refusal never echoes the string it refused. `step_index` is the
/// step's position in `probe_plan` and accompanies every per-step refusal.

fields.name: parameter_key
doc: /// The offending parameter's key, omitted when the key itself is refused;
/// the field name and byte count identify it.

fields.name: index
doc: /// The offending argv position for exec argument refusals.

fields.name: requested_kind
doc: /// Submitted intent, not proof that the named native operation ran. See
/// the "Worker evidence contract" in tests/FAILURE-PROPAGATION-CONTRACT.md
/// for PW status versus missing reasons.

fields.name: lifecycle
doc: /// Projection of this step's disposition claims. It is the evidence for
/// whether a `no_completed_result`/`slot_incomplete` step started.

fields.name: execObservationDecodeProblem
doc: // Host-local corruption diagnostic, checked by typed reporting admission.

fields.name: rc
doc: /// PW's attempt status, not a raw syscall return.

fields.name: path_diagnostics
doc: /// Host-resolved forms of the attempt target; absent for non-path attempts.

fields.name: child_pid
doc: /// Exec-attempt outputs. All five are nil and omitted for non-exec
/// attempts. Present values retain the observed child status or stream text.
/// `child_pid > 0` means `posix_spawn` produced a child; it does not
/// establish reaping. Unconfirmed status keeps exit -1 / signal 0.
/// Attempt rc may fail independently of a natural leader exit.
/// `child_pid == 0` means
/// spawn/setup did not produce a child; this alone does not identify
/// the cause. `errno` carries the applicable native error in
/// that case. comparisonEvidence reads `child_pid` to distinguish
/// spawn failure from a child non-zero exit. EPERM/EACCES without
/// a child remain ambiguous: execute permissions can also prevent
/// spawning.

fields.name: handle_ref
doc: /// Present for consume/release; absent on issue and transfer.

fields.name: actor_id
doc: // Actor form: the acting actor, the family operands and references.

fields.name: worker_lifetime_established
doc: /// Ownership through acknowledgement, not the eventual cleanup outcome.

fields.name: actor_id
doc: /// Actor form: the activated actor and its 1-based visit ordinal, and the
/// host-measured intervals of the visit.

fields.name: policy_format
doc: /// The legacy form's policy format and hash; absent for the actor form,
/// whose actors carry their own.

fields.name: execution_form
doc: /// Actor assembly emits `actors`; the ordinary producer omits this field.

fields.name: result_source
doc: /// Result provenance. See the "Worker evidence contract" in
/// tests/FAILURE-PROPAGATION-CONTRACT.md for native returns versus PW
/// status and missing reasons.

fields.name: comparison
doc: /// Present on every step of an ordinary reply; withheld by a
/// `runner_reporting_failed` reply.

fields.name: actor_id
doc: /// Actor form: the actor whose process ran this step.

fields.name: term_signal
doc: /// JSON integers, meaningful only after waitpid returned this child's PID.
/// Both may be absent/null when status was not obtained; zero is a real exit.

fields.name: worker_evidence
doc: /// Worker publication snapshot; absent before spawn.

fields.name: policy_transfer_timeout
doc: /// Host transfer observation independent of any child publication.

fields.name: ready_byte_received
doc: /// Host read of the ready byte; false does not prove compilation failed.

fields.name: done_observed
doc: /// Final acquire observation of done after cleanup, not successful application.
/// poll_stop_reason separately retains the reason the polling stage ended.

fields.name: poll_stop_reason
doc: /// Host string: done, child_reaped, sentinel_deadline, wait_error, policy_write_error, or policy_transfer_deadline.
/// Identifies why polling stopped; later cleanup must not rewrite it.
/// Only sentinel_deadline establishes exhaustion of the polling budget.
/// Unknown strings survive decoding; they do not imply a known condition.

fields.name: exit_requested
doc: /// Host performed the release-store of exit_requested; not worker receipt.

fields.name: reaped
doc: /// True only when waitpid actually returned this PID. False is explicitly
/// unconfirmed disposition, distinct from an absent/null observation.

fields.name: cleanup_trigger
doc: /// Host facts recorded where the host acts (tests/FAILURE-PROPAGATION-CONTRACT.md,
/// "Worker disposition record"): why exit was requested, how the exit-grace
/// wait ended, and whether the final reads followed a confirmed reap.
/// Absence is unreported, not observed false.

fields.name: ready_wait
doc: /// Measured host waits: readiness hint, publication (sentinel) and exit grace.
/// Absent when the stage did not run.

fields.name: disposition
doc: /// The canonical lifecycle account, resolved once by the host. Mandatory
/// whenever this object is present.

fields.name: recipient_wait
doc: /// The host's wait for the recipient's acknowledgement, when a copy was made.

fields.name: phase_id
doc: /// The phase this collection served, stamped by the host from the
/// collection it ran. Readers require agreement with the containing phase.

fields.name: exit_grace_wait
doc: /// The measured exit-grace wait after collection closed.

fields.name: abi_identity
doc: /// Host-selected source identity, not proof that a child reached ABI validation.
